candidates.explanation: Strong framework-neutral operation, capability-shaped provider port, SSE lifecycle, cancellation, sliding idle timeout, post-commit failure event, channel-specific handling, and provider isolation. Capability behavior is distributed across repository-wide layer roots rather than clearly colocated beneath one capability root.

Clearly separates the shared generation use case from HTTP and job contracts, with safe provider translation, abort propagation, sliding idle timeout, and in-band post-commit failures. Placement is primarily layer-oriented and does not fully colocate assistant behavior under one capability root.

Coherent capability-root design with justified framework entry point, transport-neutral application service, capability port, provider isolation, correct SSE commit behavior, cancellation and idle-timeout semantics, and native HTTP/job decisions sharing sanitized failure and reporting primitives.

Fully colocates assistant internals while retaining justified Route Handler and worker surfaces. It clearly preserves a framework-neutral operation and provider seam, handles abort and inactivity correctly, changes failure representation after commit, keeps HTTP and job contracts distinct, and prevents provider details from leaking.
